tasks.title: Resolve the two published intercompany transfers
tasks.method: Search later public filings referring to Danelia complaint paragraph47, with docket and exact amount/date checks.
tasks.acceptance_evidence: A court filing identifies the counterparty and transaction purpose with supporting records.
tasks.disconfirmation_or_stop_condition: Keep entities unidentified if no explicit source; close any name-only or amount-only match.
tasks.current_evidence_boundary: Public complaint; later filings not acquired as complete docket.

tasks.title: Reconcile Centennial payer receipts and escrow
tasks.method: Compare dated complaint, indictment, later restitution/forfeiture and official recovery figures, keeping claims and cash separate.
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Payer-specific receipt window and recovery disposition agree across records.
tasks.disconfirmation_or_stop_condition: Do not count withheld escrow as received loss or add overlapping claims/receipts.
tasks.current_evidence_boundary: Public filing summaries available; transaction-level ledger absent.

tasks.title: Resolve the earlier-revocation cohort screen
tasks.method: For anonymous screened matches, distinguish enrollment identifier, revocation date, notice date, appeals, reinstatement, service date and payment date.
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Exact same enrollment has unreversed revocation plus eligible claim-level timing and cash reconciliation.
tasks.disconfirmation_or_stop_condition: Downgrade if another enrollment, reversal, earlier service, lagged claim or other legitimate explanation resolves overlap.
tasks.current_evidence_boundary: Bounded public follow-up completed: one candidate has another approved immunization-only enrollment; the other has no selected enrollment hits. Neither historical 2024 catheter eligibility nor billed enrollment is resolved. See enrollment/candidate_followup_summary.json.

tasks.title: Check effectiveness of supplemental-payer suspension notifications
tasks.method: Search official material after January2026 for distribution coverage, transmission latency, implementation and residual payment findings.
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Dated independent implementation evidence, including denominator and residual exposure.
tasks.disconfirmation_or_stop_condition: Do not describe the historical gap as unchanged merely because outcome data is missing.
tasks.current_evidence_boundary: GAO documents sharing begun; current effectiveness incomplete.

tasks.title: Acquire 2025 supplier data when publicly released
tasks.method: Resolve current CMS catalog, preserve immutable dataset ID, metadata, dictionary and selected cohort capture.
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Counts/pagination/hashes validated and 2025 service year explicitly published.
tasks.disconfirmation_or_stop_condition: Stop at absent release; never relabel a2024 file as2025.
tasks.current_evidence_boundary: 2024 is the latest service year acquired in this run; no background monitor activated.

tasks.title: Resolve historical company control from published filings
tasks.method: Read dated acquisition/amendment/manager records; distinguish source-reported nominee owner from beneficial controller.
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Identifier match, effective dates and direct evidence for each claimed role.
tasks.disconfirmation_or_stop_condition: Registered agent or authorized official alone does not prove ownership.
tasks.current_evidence_boundary: Exact NPI and current corporate roles acquired; full beneficial chain unresolved.

tasks.title: Track adjudication and collected recoveries
tasks.method: Check official later pleas, judgments, restitution, forfeiture and collection statements for each named defendant separately.
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Dated case event and collection evidence rather than scheduled event/order alone.
tasks.disconfirmation_or_stop_condition: Keep charged defendants presumed innocent; never upgrade all network participants from one conviction.
tasks.current_evidence_boundary: Current official status updates captured; complete live dockets not certified.

tasks.title: Identify the eleven September2026 suppliers only from explicit sources
tasks.method: Look for CMS/OIG/DOJ releases or public appeal decisions explicitly naming the suppliers and identifiers.
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Source itself ties exact supplier to the specific announcement.
tasks.disconfirmation_or_stop_condition: No inferred identities from geography, spending size, LEIE or unrelated revocations.
tasks.current_evidence_boundary: September announcement does not name them; Preclusion List not public.

tasks.title: Separate CHAMPVA and other public-program claims from disbursement
tasks.method: Use later public filings to establish whether billed CHAMPVA/TRICARE claims were paid, withheld, rejected or recovered.
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Payer-specific amounts and dates with supporting source.
tasks.disconfirmation_or_stop_condition: Do not convert a billed figure into paid loss or assume program labels are interchangeable.
tasks.current_evidence_boundary: Complaint has billed CHAMPVA amount with payment unknown.

tasks.title: Evaluate detector false positives on a separate cohort
tasks.method: Predeclare features and evaluate with independent adjudicated examples and benign controls outside training case set.
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Observed sensitivity/precision with a defensible labeled denominator and time split.
tasks.disconfirmation_or_stop_condition: No calibrated fraud probability from a hand-picked Gold Rush benchmark.
